armySpecialRules.name: DIRTY FIGHTING
armySpecialRules.description: All models with this special rule gain +1 To Hit in the first round of close combat.

armySpecialRules.name: MASTERS AND IDLERS
armySpecialRules.description:
Masters and Idlers are upgrades for certain units, follow the rules for normal Command Group models. You may have one Master and Idler of each sort for every Pirate Captain or Pirate Lord in your army.
• Bosun: A unit with a Bosun gains the Cold-Blooded special rule.
• Look-Out: A character within 6" of a unit with a Look-Out may re-roll failed "Look out, Sir!" tests, and characters in the unit may use the rule even if they are below 5 models.
• Master Gunner: A unit with a Master Gunner joined can re-roll 1's when rolling To Hit with blunderbusses, handguns and pistols. If he is part of a War Machine crew, that war machine may re-roll one Artillery Dice per game.
• Pilot: A unit with a Pilot gains the Ambushers special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: NAVAL BOMBARDMENT
armySpecialRules.description: Once per game, you may fire D3 Cannon shots in the shooting phase from the edge of your deployment zone for every full 1000 points of game size you are playing. Each shot is fired from a separate point within a 45° angle no more than 3" apart from each other, and with a Line of Sight value of 3. If a Misfire is rolled, count the result as a "May not Shoot".

armySpecialRules.name: RACIAL DISTRUST
armySpecialRules.description: Most models belong to a certain race as detailed in their Troop Type. This includes Human, Dwarf, Ogre and Orc. Characters may only join units belonging to the same race.

armySpecialRules.name: SEA LEGS
armySpecialRules.description: All models with this special rule may re-roll failed Dangerous Terrain tests.

armySpecialRules.name: HARPOON LAUNCHER
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 5 | Multiple Wounds (D3), Ponderous

armySpecialRules.name: VOLLEY GUN
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
9/18" | 5 | Multiple Shots (D6), Ponderous

magicItems.name: TIDAL BLADE
magicItems.description: Each successful Hit made with this weapon penetrates ranks like a bolt thrower.

magicItems.name: STORM TRIDENT
magicItems.description: Attacks made with this weapon have the Lightning Attacks special rule. Additionally, all natural To Wound rolls of 6 with the weapon have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: SERPENT CUTLASS
magicItems.description: Attacks made with this weapon are made with +1 Strength and have the Poisoned Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: SQUALL SABRE
magicItems.description: This weapon grants its wielder a Strength 3 Breath Weapon and Immunity (Flaming Attacks). Enemy units hit by this Breath Weapon lose the Flaming Attacks special rule until the beginning of the wielder’s next turn.

magicItems.name: WAVECUTTER
magicItems.description: This weapon does not suffer the normal Initiative penalties for being a great weapon. Additionally, the wielder can choose to exchange all of their Attacks to make a special attack. If they do so, all enemy models in base contact with the wielder suffer a single automatic hit. In a challenge, only the model engaged in the challenge count as being in base contact with the wielder.

magicItems.name: BLOODY BOARDING AXE
magicItems.description: The wielder gains the Mighty Blow (1) special rule. In addition, they suffer no penalties when attacking units that are garrisoned or defending an obstacle.

magicItems.name: CROW'S FEET
magicItems.description: After resolving a Stand and Shoot charge reaction with this weapon against a non-Flying charging unit, the unit must immediately take 2D6 dangerous terrain tests, up to the number of models in the unit. For each failed test, the enemy unit suffers -1 to their charge distance roll against the wielder’s unit.

magicItems.name: PISTOLS OF KING DEATH
magicItems.description: All failed To Hit and To Wound rolls with missile attacks from these weapons may be re- rolled.

magicItems.name: STROMFEL'S FIN
magicItems.description: Attacks made with this weapon have the Killing Blow special rule, and may reroll failed To Wound rolls when attacking a unit or model containing one or more models that have suffered one or more Wounds (excluding slain models).

magicItems.name: EL CADAVO'S HOOK-HAND
magicItems.description: Attacks made with this weapon have the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: STORMRIDER ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer’s armour save can never be reduced to less than 6+, and they have the Immunity (Lightning Attacks) special rule. Additionally, any time the wearer makes a successful armour save in close combat, they inflict a Strength 4 Hit with the Lightning Attacks special rule on the attacker.

magicItems.name: BARNACLE COAT
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Regeneration (6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: MEGALADON HELMET
magicItems.description: The wearer gains a 6+ armour save and the Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: KRAKEN COAT
magicItems.description: At the start of each round of close combat, the Kraken Cloak causes one enemy model in base contact of your choosing to suffer a -1 penalty to their Attack characteristic for the remainder of the close combat phase.

magicItems.name: SEA SERPENT SCALES
magicItems.description: The wearer has the Immunity (Poisoned Attacks) and Natural Armour (6+) special rules.

magicItems.name: BLACK BARNABUS' BUCKLER
magicItems.description: The wielder may reroll failed Parry saves.

magicItems.name: COIN OF THE BETRAYER
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a 3+ Ward save. However, for every roll of a natural 1 when taking Ward saves, they suffer D3 Wounds instead of 1.

magicItems.name: THE BLACK SPOT
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Fear special rule. In addition, enemies attacking the bearer in close combat suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: WHALEBONE CHARM
magicItems.description: When used, enemies must re-roll successful rolls To Wound against the wearer for the duration of the turn. In addition, whenever the wearer would normally lose their last Wound, this is automatically negated on a 2+.

magicItems.name: THE GUNNARSSON KRON
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains +1 Toughness.

magicItems.name: POLLY THE PARROT
magicItems.description: All enemies attempting to strike the bearer of this item must re-roll 6's To Hit in close combat. In addition, the bearer gains a 3+ Ward save against War Machines.

magicItems.name: SHARKTOOTH NECKLACE
magicItems.description: The model has the Immunity (Killing Blow, Multiple Wounds) special rule. Additionally, enemies must reroll To Wound rolls of 6's against them.

magicItems.name: LUCKY GOLDEN TOOTH
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll failed armour and Ward saves.

magicItems.name: SWASHBUCKLER'S BOOTS
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Dodge (6+) special rule. Additionally, they may freely change their position in the front rank of their unit at the beginning of every close combat phase, unless in a challenge.

magicItems.name: ARCANE ASTROLABE
magicItems.description: When used, the model bearing this item may re-roll the result from the Winds of Magic in your turn.

magicItems.name: GROUNDING LODESTONE
magicItems.description: Whenever the bearer of this item must roll on the Miscast table, subtract 1 from the result.

magicItems.name: AETHYRIC ANCHOR
magicItems.description: The Wizard may ignore their first miscast. If they do so, they cannot voluntarily move until the beginning of their next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: DROWNING EFFIGY
magicItems.description: The bearer may reroll failed To Wound rolls caused by the Kiss of the Deep Lore Attribute when casting spells from the Lore of the Deep.

magicItems.name: HELLFIRE POWDER
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item, and any unit they join, add +1 Strength to all their missile attacks (except javelins, harpoon launchers and throwing weapons). However, every To Hit roll of 1 with their missile attacks inflicts a Hit from the weapon on the shooter instead.

magicItems.name: STORM IN A BOTTLE
magicItems.description: This item contains the Storm of Cronos spell from the Lore of Heavens.

magicItems.name: REYNO BLOODLOCK'S HAT
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule.

magicItems.name: BLACKEYE PEARL
magicItems.description: The Blackeye Pearl gives the model the Sniper special rule. In addition, the bearer may pick one enemy unit within Line of Sight at the start of each of your turns. Your opponent must reveal all Magic Items, Hidden models and the like that unit might have.

magicItems.name: FIREWATER
magicItems.description: The Firewater may be used at the start of any Shooting or Close Combat phase. The model gains a Strength 3 Breath Weapon with the Flaming Attacks special rule for the remainder of the phase.

magicItems.name: CURSED MOONSHINE
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any of your turns. When used, the bearer gains the Frenzy and Terror special rules until the beginning of your next turn.

magicItems.name: SALTY SKIPPER'S PIPE
magicItems.description: The model has the Immunity (Psychology) special rule. In addition, any unit they join may reroll failed Panic tests.

magicItems.name: BLACK BUCKTHORN'S TREASURE MAP
magicItems.description: Black Buckthorn's Treasure Map adds +1 to the dice rolled when determining which side to deploy on.

magicItems.name: WILLEM LONGTOOTH'S PEG LEG
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Stomp (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE SMUGGLER'S SATCHEL
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may take an additional Talisman, Arcane Item or Enchanted Item.

magicItems.name: MAELSTROM BANNER
magicItems.description: At the beginning of each of your turns, enemy units within 12" of the standard are ‘pulled’ directly towards the unit by D3” (they do not change facing). If the target unit comes into contact with another unit or impassable terrain, it stops 1" away. Additionally, any enemy unit fleeing from combat while in base contact with the unit suffers a -D3 penalty to their Flee distance.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF BOUNTIFUL TREASURE
magicItems.description: Each enemy standard captured by the unit carrying this standard gives them an addition +1 to their combat resolution score. In addition, any captured standards by this unit are worth twice their normal Victory Points.

magicItems.name: BOATSWAIN'S BURGEES
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: PRESS-GANGER STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard may re-roll their Pursuit distance. In addition, they inflict twice the number of casualties when pursuing enemy units than normal.

magicItems.name: SKULL AND CROSSBONES
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Terror and Vanguard special rules.

magicItems.name: BLOODY JACK'S FLAG
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard may re-roll failed To Wound rolls in close combat.

magicItems.name: GONFALON O' THE GREEN HANDS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +1 To Hit with missile weapons.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF THE DEEP
loresOfMagic.attribute: Whenever a spell from the Lore of the Deep is cast on an enemy unit, that unit also suffers D6 Strength 1 Hits which Ignores Armour Saves in addition to the effects of the spell.

spells.name: TIDECALL
spells.description: Tidecall is a direct damage spell. The caster makes a Strength 2 Breath Weapon Attack with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. This may be cast in close combat, following the normal rules for Breath Weapons.

spells.name: BLOOD IN THE WATER
spells.description: Blood in the Water is an augment spell with a range of 18". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, all models in the target unit gets to immediately make an additional Attack for every unsaved Wound they cause in Close Combat. These Attacks can generate additional Attacks to a maximum of +2 Attacks per attacking model in the unit.

spells.name: COUNTER-CURRENT
spells.description: Remains in play. Counter-Current is a hex spell with a range of 24". While the spell is in effect, the target halves all its movement (rounding up) while moving closer to the caster and while being within their front arc.

spells.name: FOG OF THE DAMNED
spells.description: Remains in Play. Fog of the Damned is a hex spell with a range of 24". While the spell is in effect, the target cannot gain combat resolution bonuses from Ranks or Outnumber.

spells.name: PRESSURE OF THE DEEP
spells.description: Pressure of the Deep is a direct damage spell with a range of 12" that targets a single enemy model (even a character in a unit). The target must take D6 Toughness tests. Each failed Toughness test causes a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

spells.name: ABYSSAL DARKNESS
spells.description: Abyssal Darkness is an augment spell that is cast on the Wizard itself. Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase all missile attacks targeted at the Wizard and any unit they are with suffer a -1 To Hit penalty, and enemies need to be within 18" to be able to draw Line of Sight to them.

spells.name: GAZE INTO THE ABYSS
spells.description: Gaze Into the Abyss is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit suffers -1 Weapon Skill, -1 Initiative and -2 Leadership until the start of the caster's next Magic Phase.

spells.name: STEED OF TIDES
spells.description: Steed of Tides is a conveyance spell with a range of 18". The target is immediately picked up and may be moved to any position on the battlefield within 3D6" of their original position (or within any water terrain feature on the battlefield), just like a summoning spell.

spells.name: WATERY GRAVE
spells.description: Watery Grave is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit counts as moving through dangerous terrain until the start of the caster's next Magic phase. For every 4" the unit moves while the spell is in effect, the chance of them failing the test increases by +1.

spells.name: ARCANE CORRASION
spells.description: Arcane Corrasion is a magic missile that causes a number of Strength 4 Hits depending on the distance to the target. If the target is within less than 12" it suffers D6 Hits. If the target is within 12" to 24" it suffers 2D6 Hits. If the target is within 24" to 36" it suffers 3D6 Hits.

spells.name: DENIZENS OF THE DEEP
spells.description: Denizens of the Deep is a direct damage spell with a range of 24" that causes 6D6 Strength 2 Hits.

spells.name: KRAKEN'S PULL
spells.description: Remains in Play. Kraken's Pull is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template must pass a Strength test or suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

spells.name: VORPAL MAELSTROM
spells.description: Vorpal Maelstrom is a direct damage spell. Place the large template anywhere within 18" of the Wizard; it then scatters D6". All models under the template suffer a Strength Hit equal to their Unit Strength plus 2. In addition, any surviving models will have their Movement value lowered by half until the start of the caster's next Magic Phase.
